att-exports-from-attestations: forall exports e: exists a: source(e) == a and signed(a)
att-signed-acceptance: forall acceptances a: signed(a, bind(contract_ver, clause_hashes, tree_hash, gate_log, tools))
con-amend-via-deltas: forall changes ch: applied(ch) => kind(ch) in {ADDED, MODIFIED, REMOVED}
con-counter-recorded: forall counters c: recorded(c) and exists d: decision(d, c) and recorded(decision(d, c))
con-typed-rejections: forall rejections r: names(r, clause_ids) and names(r, fault_kind)
con-validated-or-no-start: forall orders o: implemented(o) => exists c: contains(c, o) and status(c) == VALIDATED
dsl-compile-generators: forall predicates p in DSL: compiles(p, generators) and executable(p)
dsl-judge-escape-hatch: forall clauses c: not expressible(c) => kind(c)==judge and rationale(c) != empty
dsl-trigger-predicate-enforcement: forall clauses c: expressed(c) => has(c, trigger, predicate, enforcement)
gate-duplicate-clauses: forall a, b: content_hash(a) == content_hash(b) => fails_L0(duplicates(a, b))
gate-evidence-kind: forall acceptances a, clauses c: kind(c)==property => evidence(a, c).type == property_run
gate-judge-quarantine: forall exports e, clauses c: kind(c)==judge => excluded(c, e.deterministic_coverage) and labeled(c, judge, e)
gate-l0-hash-verify: forall gates g, clauses c: member_of(c, g) => recomputed(c) == stored(c)
gate-mutation-attribution: kill_rate(c) < threshold => fault(under_specified, c) and route(consumer)
id-conflict-halt: forall merges m: concurrent_edits(m) => halted(m) and structured_diff(m)
id-content-change: content_changed(n) => next_hash(n) != hash(n) and next_ver(n) == ver(n)+1 and next_id(n) == id(n)
id-uuidv7-alias: forall nodes n: valid_v7(n.id) and unique(n.alias)
prt-typed-refusal: forall tasks t, producers p: missing_capability(p, t) => responds(p, refuse(t)) and stage(t) == PRE_COMMITMENT
tr-deterministic-extraction: forall runs r1, r2: inputs_equal(r1, r2) => manifest(r1) == manifest(r2)
tr-forward-coverage: forall clauses c in contract: covered(c) in manifest
tr-impact-query: forall changes ch: impact(ch) == {c | bound(c, element(ch))}
tr-reverse-coverage: forall elements e: bound(e) or member_of(e, manifest.out_of_contract)
tr-unresolved-bindings-fail: forall bindings b: resolvable(alias(b)) or fails_L0(location(b))
